Now I have all the data. Here are the final answers:

---

**h01:** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:162-169`, called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02:** Delivery function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (called by 4 async goroutines consuming from `asyncPostQueue`, dispatched via `PostAsync` at line 184). Protection mechanism — `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` (re-resolves DNS at dial time and blocks reserved/private IPs) plus `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62` (validates URL scheme and resolves DNS against reserved ranges at registration time).

**h03:** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct in `internal/idp/idp.go`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 implementation in `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

**h04:** No; the MySQL driver is never constructed directly outside the factory. `mysql.NewDB` is only called from `store/db/db.go:22` in the `NewDBDriver` switch. No other file imports the `store/db/mysql` package (verified by grepping for the import path).

**h05:** Explicit Go code; the `deleteUserTargetsTx` function in each driver (e.g., `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:92`) explicitly deletes reactions in two steps: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memos, line ~95) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions the user placed on others' memos, line ~97). The `reaction` table has no foreign key / `ON DELETE CASCADE` constraint (verified in `store/migration/*/LATEST.sql`). Only `memo_share` has `ON DELETE CASCADE`.

**h06:** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`, via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`), `DeleteMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`, via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`), `SetMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`, via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`). Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07:**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `Driver.ListUsers` (e.g. `sqlite.DB.ListUsers`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`
- `FileServerService.parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737` (decodes the base64 data-URI stored in `avatar_url` column)

**h08:**
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` declared at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked from production code: `server/server.go:163` (called by `startBackgroundRunners`) and self-called in its ticker loop at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`.
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` declared at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — NOT invoked from any production (non-test) code.

**h09:** 8 distinct declarations of `Close`: `SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), plus 2 in test code (`store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`). Invoked by non-test server code: `Store.Close` called by `server/server.go:146`; `SSEHub.Close` called by `server/server.go:206`; `Cache.Close` called by `store/store.go:74-76` (3 cache instances); `driver.Close` (sqlite/postgres/mysql) called by `store/store.go:78`.

**h10:** `util.GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — approx 7 callers (tied with `filter.DefaultEngine` at `internal/filter/engine.go:111`, also ~7 callers).

**h11:** 1st: `User` (~12 packages including tests, 6 non-test); 2nd: `Memo` (~11 packages including tests, 6 non-test). `Attachment` is 3rd (~9 packages).

**h12:** `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`. Determination: the default driver is `"sqlite"` per `cmd/memos/main.go:122` (`viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`), so the factory `store/db/db.go:20` selects `sqlite.NewDB`, meaning the `sqlite.DB` implementation of the `Driver` interface handles all SQL operations including `CreateMemo`.

**h13:** Implementation: `markdown.service` (private struct, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`), backed by goldmark. Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` called in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`. Holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14:** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`) which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and `UpdateMemo` content changes (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`). Extracted properties: `Tags` (list of #tags), `HasLink`, `HasTaskList`, `HasCode`, `HasIncompleteTasks`, and `Title` (first H1 heading).

**h15:**
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-225`
- `ListMemoReactions` / `UpsertMemoReaction` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30,83`
- Attachment access via memo visibility — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:436-451`
- `GetMemoAttachment` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-222`
- SSE delivery filtering (`canReceive`) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- RSS feed (public only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- Memo relation listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:109-111`

**r01:** False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. Caching uses an in-memory `sync.Map`-based cache (`store/cache/cache.go`) with a default TTL of 10 minutes, cleanup interval of 5 minutes, and max 1000 items. No external cache service is used.

**r02:** False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware in the codebase. No references to rate limiting, throttling, or any rate-limit middleware exist anywhere in the Go code.

**r03:** False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The codebase contains a general-purpose scheduler package (`internal/scheduler/`), but it is not used for any nightly cleanup. The only scheduled background runners are the S3 presign URL refresher (every 12 hours) wired in `server/server.go`.

**r04:** False premise. Webhook delivery does not use any external message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ). Webhooks are dispatched via an in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) consumed by 4 goroutines started in `init()`. No external queue is declared.

**r05:** False premise. There is no GraphQL schema or API. The public API surface is gRPC + gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON) + Connect (for browser clients), defined via Protocol Buffers in `proto/api/v1/` with generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1/`.
